content.what_it_is: MATLAB case-C benchmark plotter. It loads C.txt and station outputs for gauges 6, 9, 16 and 22, applies a fixed 22.63 shift to model times, and plots four measured/model surface-elevation comparisons with shared limits (L1-L47).
entities: t, measure, tmodel and model arrays at L10-L25
gauge labels and ax at L27-L32
calls: clear all at L1; load at L2-L6; clf at L34; subplot/plot/title/ylabel/grid/axis/xlabel in L36-L45
unresolved: The case-C script stores its 22.63 shift in `time_lag_case_A`, a cross-case copy/name inconsistency. All four modeled traces depend on this value, so its provenance should be verified against case C rather than inferred from the variable name.
The horizontal values are time columns and are shifted by a time lag, yet the x-axis is labeled `x (m)`. This is a direct dimension/label defect; viewers can misread seconds as distance.
Fixed limits [25,41,-0.06,0.1] silently clip input outside the expected window. No loaded-column or finite-value validation is performed.
Gauge-to-station mapping exists only in comments and assignments (6→0001, 9→0002, 16→0008, 22→0013), so correctness depends on external station ordering.
